title: ResNet50 deep learning screens for osteoporosis on chest X-rays
summary: Using chest X-rays from 1995 patients treated at Chongqing Daping Hospital (2019-2024), transfer-learned ResNet50 outperformed Inception v3 and VGG16, with internal AUCs of 0.945 and 0.957 and accuracies of 87.85% and 90.38% in two experiments. In an external dataset it reached AUC 0.904, accuracy 89%, sensitivity 90% and specificity 88.57%.
ai_technology: Transfer-learned ResNet50 (also Inception v3 and VGG16) on chest X-ray images

evidence.tested: Internal test sets and an external validation dataset.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; single-center development; external set size not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep neural networks classify osteoporosis from chest X-rays opportunistically.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Author affiliations and publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
